===== check-integrity.py =====
import json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('.temp/BUG-261018-uoisfe/r7'); ident=json.loads((b/'identity.json').read_text())
def git(*args,env=None):
 return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],env=env,text=True).strip()
index=b.resolve()/'integrity.index'
if index.exists():index.unlink()
env=os.environ.copy();env['GIT_INDEX_FILE']=str(index)
git('read-tree','HEAD',env=env);git('add','-A',env=env)
tree=git('write-tree',env=env)
head=git('rev-parse','HEAD');candidate=ident['candidate']
assert head==ident['checkpoint'],('Story branch moved',head)
assert tree==ident['tree']==git('rev-parse',candidate+'^{tree}'),('tree mismatch',tree)
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only'),'actual index changed'
signature=git('log','-1','--format=%G?',candidate);assert signature=='G',signature
main=git('rev-parse','origin/main')
paths=set(git('diff','--name-only',head,candidate).splitlines())
upstream=set(git('diff','--name-only',head,main).splitlines())
overlap=sorted(paths&upstream);assert not overlap,overlap
for f in ['README.md','CHANGELOG.md']:
 assert not git('diff','--name-only',ident['prior'],candidate,'--',f),f
branch=(b/'branch.txt').read_text().strip()
remote=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/'+branch).split()[0]
assert remote==candidate,remote
result={'checkpoint':head,'candidate':candidate,'tree':tree,'signature':signature,'fresh_remote_main':main,'upstream_overlap':overlap,'published_gate_head':remote,'actual_index_empty':True,'source_matches_signed_snapshot':True,'root_README_and_CHANGELOG_unchanged':True,'rework_delta':git('diff','--name-only',ident['prior'],candidate).splitlines()}
(b/'final-integrity.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
index.unlink();print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

===== pack-evidence.py =====
import json,re,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('.temp/BUG-261018-uoisfe/r7')
def clean(s):
 s=s.replace(str(Path.cwd()),'<worktree>')
 s=re.sub(r"(?:/private)?<temporary-path>"'<>]+",'<temporary-path>',s)
 s=re.sub(r"<local-path>"'<>]+",'<local-path>',s)
 s=re.sub(r"<runner-path>"'<>]+",'<runner-path>',s)
 s=re.sub(r"[A-Za-z]:\\+Users\\+[^\s\"'<>]+",'<local-path>',s)
 s=re.sub(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}','<redacted-email>',s)
 s=re.sub(r'\b(?:ghp_|github_pat_|sk-(?:proj-)?)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}','<redacted-token>',s)
 s=s.replace("<user-home-prefix>/","<user-home-prefix>/").replace("<runner-home-prefix>/","<runner-home-prefix>/")
 return s
def scrub(v):
 if isinstance(v,str):return clean(v)
 if isinstance(v,list):return [scrub(x) for x in v]
 if isinstance(v,dict):return {clean(k):scrub(x) for k,x in v.items()}
 return v
def payload(p):
 s=p.read_text()
 if p.suffix in ['.json','.jsonl']:
  try:return (json.dumps(scrub(json.loads(s)),indent=2)+'\n').encode()
  except json.JSONDecodeError:return ('\n'.join(json.dumps(scrub(json.loads(line)),separators=(',',':')) for line in s.splitlines() if line.strip())+'\n').encode()
 return clean(s).encode()

control=clean('<local-path> <runner-path> <local-path> <redacted-email> ghp_'+'x'*30)
assert all(x not in control for x in ['<user-home-prefix>/','<runner-home-prefix>/','<redacted-email>','ghp_','C:'])

 assert payload(b/'full-local-merged.json')==(b/'full-local-sanitized.json').read_bytes(),'published stream differs from gated sanitized stream'
